details: Conflicting reports emerged regarding a potential peace deal between the US and Iran. While US President Donald Trump initially indicated an agreement was "largely negotiated," he later cautioned against rushing the deal, stating significant differences remain. Iran's Revolutionary Guards reported that 33 vessels passed through the Strait of Hormuz in the past 24 hours with Tehran's permission, a number still significantly below the typical daily traffic before the conflict. The US blockade on Iranian ships in the Strait of Hormuz is expected to remain in full effect until a final agreement is reached, impacting global energy prices and inflation.
title: US-Iran Deal Progress Unclear, Strait of Hormuz Blockade Persists

details: Russia launched a significant aerial assault on Kyiv overnight on May 23-24, involving approximately 600 drones and 90 missiles, including the Oreshnik hypersonic ballistic missile. This attack resulted in at least two fatalities and over 80 injuries. Despite the severity, cryptocurrency markets did not show an immediate significant reaction. However, previous escalations in the Russia-Ukraine conflict have been linked to changes in Bitcoin trading volumes and increased interest in stablecoins for circumventing sanctions, prompting ongoing regulatory scrutiny on stablecoin providers.
title: Russia Attacks Kyiv with Drones and Missiles
